name: Legendary Gnollish War Bow
upgradeable: Malleable to Legendary Bloody War Bow Legendary Destructive War Bow Legendary Infectious War Bow Legendary Petrifying War Bow

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus : +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Crippling
effects.tooltip: Crippling : A crippling weapon is infused with binding power so that when a target is critically hit their movement is slowed by half. Note: Real slowdown is only 25%

effects.name: Bonesplitter
effects.tooltip: Bonesplitter : This weapon is powerful enough to shatter the bones of those it strikes. On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit, the weapon breaks multiple bones in the target's body, causing significant impairment. Creatures with skeletons take 40d6 damage and will have their movement and attacks slowed by 25% and their attack damage reduced by 25% when their bones are shattered.

effects.name: Monstrous Humanoid Bane
effects.tooltip: Monstrous Humanoid Bane 6 : This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt those who are descended from monsters dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Monstrous Humanoids.

effects.name: Malleable
effects.tooltip: Malleable : This item has a magical aura of malleability and can be combined with any item that has the Fusible property to create a new, more powerful fusion of the two items.

flavor_text: Gnoll archers are sought throughout Droaam for their skilled marksmanship. This powerful bow, which lets the user apply a greater amount of his or her strength to the launch of its arrows, is equally sought-after.
